title: Character concept image
description: A full-body character in an A-pose, front view, plain white background - the framing rigging tools expect. Describe only the person and outfit; no held items.
prompt_template: {prompt}. {style} Standing in an A-pose, arms straight and held about 45 degrees away from the body, fingers together, legs shoulder-width apart, feet pointing forward. Full body from head to toe, front view, orthographic, eye-level, centered, the character fills 90% of the frame height, nothing cropped. Stylized 3D game character render, clean readable shapes. Soft even studio lighting, no harsh shadows. No hand-held props, no text, no ground shadow. Plain white background.
